title: Tiny, cute burger
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- soft glow behind burger -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  
  <!-- top bun -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#E8A030'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='28' ry='16' fill='#F0B840'/>
  
  <!-- sesame seeds -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='24' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FFF8E0' transform='rotate(-20 38 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FFF8E0' transform='rotate(5 50 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='25' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FFF8E0' transform='rotate(25 62 25)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='29' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#FFF8E0' transform='rotate(-10 44 29)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='29' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#FFF8E0' transform='rotate(15 57 29)'/>
  
  <!-- lettuce -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='30' ry='8' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='41' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='41' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='43' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#81C784'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='43' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#81C784'/>
  
  <!-- cheese -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='56' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- patty -->
  <rect x='21' y='50' width='58' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='23' y='50' width='54' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0703C'/>
  
  <!-- tomato -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#E53935'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='61' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#EF5350'/>
  
  <!-- bottom bun -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='27' ry='12' fill='#D08820'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='27' ry='10' fill='#E8A030'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='24' ry='8' fill='#F0B840'/>
  
  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='58' r='3' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='58' r='3' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='57.5' r='1.5' fill='#4A2800'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='57.5' r='1.5' fill='#4A2800'/>
  
  <!-- tiny smile -->
  <path d='M45 64 Q50 68 55 64' stroke='#FFFDE0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='62' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='62' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
